short_bio: English-born comedian and host of HBO’s Last Week Tonight.
biography:
John Oliver was born in Birmingham, England, and studied English at Christ’s College, Cambridge, where he was part of the Footlights comedy club. He worked on British panel shows and stand-up before moving to the United States.

He joined The Daily Show as a correspondent in 2006 and fronted the programme during Jon Stewart’s 2013 summer break.

Last Week Tonight premiered on HBO in 2014; each episode leads with a long segment on a single subject, from civil forfeiture to the regulation of the debt-collection industry.
